name: Sure
description: Take full control of your money with Sure, the all-in-one personal finance app built for every stage of life. Link your bank accounts, stocks, crypto, and credit cards from over 10,000 institutions, or add them manually via CSV import. Everything is visualized in one place, so you always know exactly where you stand.
short_desc: The personal finance app for everyone
author: Sure Finances
